variants.headline: Home world changes the charter
variants.body: The home world has changed the colony's charter. The gazette favours fair treatment of {target} rather than an adverse verdict founded upon assumption alone.

variants.headline: Colonial charter amended
variants.body: An amendment to the colony's charter has been made by the home world. The gazette favours fair treatment of {target} rather than an adverse verdict founded upon assumption alone.
